```{r}

```{r}
mape <- function(actual, predicted) {
  mean(abs((actual - predicted) / actual)) * 100
}
```

### Cartes
```{r}
airport_coords <- tibble(
  code = c("ATL","BOS","CLT","DEN","DFW","DTW","EWR","IAH","JFK","LAX",
           "LGA","MCO","MDW","MIA","MSP","ORD","PHL","PHX","SEA","SFO",
           "SLC","TPA","IAD","DCA","BWI","PDX","HOU","DAL","OAK","SJC"),
  lat  = c(33.64, 42.36, 35.21, 39.86, 32.90, 42.21, 40.69, 29.98, 40.64, 33.94,
           40.77, 28.43, 41.79, 25.80, 44.88, 41.98, 39.87, 33.44, 47.45, 37.62,
           40.79, 27.97, 38.94, 38.85, 39.18, 45.59, 29.65, 32.85, 37.72, 37.37),
  lon  = c(-84.43,-71.01,-80.94,-104.67,-97.04,-83.36,-74.17,-95.34,-73.78,-118.41,
           -73.87,-81.31,-87.75,-80.29,-93.22,-87.91,-75.24,-112.01,-122.31,-122.37,
           -111.98,-82.53,-77.46,-77.04,-76.67,-122.60,-95.28,-96.85,-122.22,-121.93)
)

top_routes <- df_expedia %>%
  group_by(route, startingAirport, destinationAirport) %>%
  summarise(prix_median = median(totalFare, na.rm = TRUE), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n >= 500) %>%
  group_by(startingAirport) %>%
  slice_max(prix_median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_max(prix_median, n = 20) %>%
  left_join(airport_coords, by = c("startingAirport" = "code")) %>%
  rename(departure_lat = lat, departure_lon = lon) %>%
  left_join(airport_coords, by = c("destinationAirport" = "code")) %>%
  rename(arrival_lat = lat, arrival_lon = lon)

usa_map <- map_data("state")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = usa_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "gray95", color = "gray70") +
  geom_curve(data = top_routes,
             aes(x = departure_lon, y = departure_lat,
                 xend = arrival_lon, yend = arrival_lat),
             color = "#FF5722", linewidth = 0.8, curvature = 0.2,
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"))) +
  geom_text(data = top_routes,
            aes(x = (departure_lon + arrival_lon) / 2,
                y = (departure_lat + arrival_lat) / 2,
                label = scales::dollar(round(prix_median))),
            color = "#333333", size = 3, vjust = -0.5) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = c(-125, -65), ylim = c(24, 50)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top routes les plus chères aux USA (1 par aéroport, min. 500 vols)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL)
```

# Clustering
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(factoextra)

# Résumé des compagnies
profil_compagnies <- df_expedia %>%
  group_by(airlineClean) %>%
  summarise(
    prix_median      = median(totalFare),
    duree_moyenne    = mean(duration_minutes),
    distance_moyenne = mean(totalTravelDistance),
    .groups          = "drop"
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("airlineClean")

# Normalisation
profil_scale <- scale(profil_compagnies)

# Méthode du coude graphique
fviz_nbclust(profil_scale, kmeans, method = "wss", k.max = 5) +
  labs(title = "Méthode du coude — nombre optimal de clusters")
```
# K optimal : 3

```{r}
set.seed(42)
kmeans_result <- kmeans(profil_scale, centers = 3, nstart = 25)

fviz_cluster(kmeans_result, data = profil_scale,
             palette      = c("#F44336", "#2196F3", "#4CAF50"),
             labelsize    = 10,
             geom         = "text",              
             ellipse.type = "norm",
             repel        = TRUE,                
             main         = "Clustering des compagnies selon prix, durée et distance") +
  theme_minimal() 

clusters_df <- tibble(
  airlineClean = rownames(profil_compagnies),
  cluster      = paste0("Cluster ", kmeans_result$cluster)
)

df_expedia <- df_expedia %>%
  mutate(airlineClean = as.character(airlineClean)) %>%
  mutate(cluster = clusters_df$cluster[match(airlineClean, clusters_df$airlineClean)])

profil_clusters <- df_expedia %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    prix_median      = median(totalFare),
    duree_moyenne    = mean(duration_minutes),
    distance_moyenne = mean(totalTravelDistance),
    n_compagnies     = n_distinct(airlineClean),
    .groups          = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(prix_median)

print(profil_clusters)
```

### Modélisation
```{r}
df_model <- df_expedia %>%
  select(totalFare, airlineClean, cabinClean, isBasicEconomy, isRefundable,
         nb_escales, days_before_flight, duration_minutes, totalTravelDistance,
         seatsRemaining, departure_hour, arrival_hour, flight_month,
         flight_weekday, coalesce_score) %>%
  drop_na()

cat("Lignes disponibles pour la modélisation :", nrow(df_model), "\n")

set.seed(42)
idx_train <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df_model)), size = floor(0.8 * nrow(df_model)))
train <- df_model[ idx_train, ]
test  <- df_model[-idx_train, ]

cat("Train :", nrow(train), "lignes\n")
cat("Test  :", nrow(test),  "lignes\n")
```

### Encodage pour XGBoost
```{r}
train_xgb <- train %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.numeric))

test_xgb <- test %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.numeric))

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data  = as.matrix(select(train_xgb, -totalFare)),
  label = train_xgb$totalFare
)

dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data  = as.matrix(select(test_xgb, -totalFare)),
  label = test_xgb$totalFare
)
```

### Baseline — Régression linéaire
```{r}
model_lm <- lm(totalFare ~ ., data = train)

pred_lm <- predict(model_lm, newdata = test)
rmse_lm <- sqrt(mean((test$totalFare - pred_lm)^2))
r2_lm   <- cor(test$totalFare, pred_lm)^2
mape_lm <- mape(test$totalFare, pred_lm)

cat("=== Régression Linéaire ===\n")
cat("RMSE :", round(rmse_lm, 2), "\n")
cat("R²   :", round(r2_lm, 4), "\n")
cat("MAPE :", round(mape_lm, 2), "%\n")
```

### Cross-validation 5-fold — Régression Linéaire
```{r}
set.seed(42)
k <- 5

# Transformer les facteurs en dummies dans un data frame
df_numeric <- as.data.frame(model.matrix(totalFare ~ ., data = df_model))
df_numeric$totalFare <- df_model$totalFare

folds <- sample(cut(seq_len(nrow(df_numeric)), breaks = k, labels = FALSE))

cv_rmse <- numeric(k)
cv_r2   <- numeric(k)

for(i in 1:k){
  idx_val <- which(folds == i)
  
  train_cv <- df_numeric[-idx_val, ]
  val_cv   <- df_numeric[ idx_val, ]
  
  model_cv <- lm(totalFare ~ ., data = train_cv)
  pred_cv  <- predict(model_cv, newdata = val_cv)
  
  cv_rmse[i] <- sqrt(mean((val_cv$totalFare - pred_cv)^2))
  cv_r2[i]   <- cor(val_cv$totalFare, pred_cv)^2
}

cat("=== Cross-validation 5-fold — Régression Linéaire ===\n")
cat("RMSE moyen :", round(mean(cv_rmse), 2), "\n")
cat("R² moyen   :", round(mean(cv_r2), 4), "\n")
``

### Random Forest
```{r}
set.seed(42)
model_rf <- ranger(
  totalFare ~ .,
  data          = train,
  num.trees     = 500,
  mtry          = floor(sqrt(ncol(train) - 1)),
  min.node.size = 5,
  importance    = "impurity",
  num.threads   = 4
)

pred_rf <- predict(model_rf, data = test)$predictions
rmse_rf <- sqrt(mean((test$totalFare - pred_rf)^2))
r2_rf   <- cor(test$totalFare, pred_rf)^2
mape_rf <- mape(test$totalFare, pred_rf)

cat("=== Random Forest ===\n")
cat("RMSE :", round(rmse_rf, 2), "\n")
cat("R²   :", round(r2_rf, 4), "\n")
cat("MAPE :", round(mape_rf, 2), "%\n")
```

### XGBoost — Tuning des hyperparamètres
```{r}
xgb_grid <- expand.grid(
  eta       = c(0.05, 0.1),
  max_depth = c(4, 6),
  nrounds   = c(100, 200)
)

resultats_grid <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(xgb_grid)) {
  params_i <- list(
    objective        = "reg:squarederror",
    eta              = xgb_grid$eta[i],
    max_depth        = xgb_grid$max_depth[i],
    subsample        = 0.7,
    colsample_bytree = 0.7,
    nthread          = 4
  )

  cv_i <- xgb.cv(
    params  = params_i,
    data    = dtrain,
    nrounds = xgb_grid$nrounds[i],
    nfold   = 3,
    verbose = 0,
    metrics = "rmse"
  )

  resultats_grid[[i]] <- tibble(
    eta       = xgb_grid$eta[i],
    max_depth = xgb_grid$max_depth[i],
    nrounds   = xgb_grid$nrounds[i],
    rmse_cv   = min(cv_i$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean)
  )

  cat("eta:", xgb_grid$eta[i],
      "| max_depth:", xgb_grid$max_depth[i],
      "| nrounds:", xgb_grid$nrounds[i],
      "| RMSE:", round(min(cv_i$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean), 2), "\n")
}

grid_results <- bind_rows(resultats_grid) %>% arrange(rmse_cv)
cat("\n=== Meilleurs hyperparamètres ===\n")
print(head(grid_results, 3))
```

```{r}
library(xgboost)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

set.seed(42)

# 1. Transformer tous les facteurs en dummies
df_numeric <- as.data.frame(model.matrix(totalFare ~ ., data = df_model))
df_numeric$totalFare <- df_model$totalFare

# 2. Séparer features et target
X <- df_numeric %>% select(-totalFare)
y <- df_numeric$totalFare

# 3. Créer DMatrix pour XGBoost
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(X), label = y)

# 4. Définir l’espace des hyperparamètres
param_space <- list(
  eta = c(0.03, 0.05, 0.07, 0.1),
  max_depth = 4:7,
  subsample = seq(0.7, 0.9, 0.05),
  colsample_bytree = seq(0.7, 0.9, 0.05),
  min_child_weight = c(1, 3, 5)
)

# 5. Fonction pour tirer aléatoirement une combinaison
sample_params <- function() {
  list(
    eta = sample(param_space$eta, 1),
    max_depth = sample(param_space$max_depth, 1),
    subsample = sample(param_space$subsample, 1),
    colsample_bytree = sample(param_space$colsample_bytree, 1),
    min_child_weight = sample(param_space$min_child_weight, 1)
  )
}

# 6. Nombre de combinaisons aléatoires à tester
n_iter <- 50

# 7. Lancer le random search
results <- map_dfr(1:n_iter, function(i) {
  params <- sample_params()
  
  cv <- xgb.cv(
    params = params,
    data = dtrain,
    nrounds = 400,
    nfold = 5,
    verbose = 0,
    metrics = "rmse",
    early_stopping_rounds = 50
  )
  
  data.frame(
    eta = params$eta,
    max_depth = params$max_depth,
    subsample = params$subsample,
    colsample_bytree = params$colsample_bytree,
    min_child_weight = params$min_child_weight,
    rmse_cv = min(cv$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean)
  )
})

# 8. Trier et afficher les meilleurs résultats
best_results <- results %>% arrange(rmse_cv)
cat("\n=== Meilleurs hyperparamètres (Random Search) ===\n")
print(head(best_results, 10))
  
  
```


```{r}
set.seed(42)

# Préparation des matrices XGBoost
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(train_xgb %>% select(-totalFare)), label = train_xgb$totalFare)
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(test_xgb %>% select(-totalFare)),  label = test_xgb$totalFare)

# Hyperparamètres optimaux issus du Random Search (RMSE minimal)
params_extended <- list(
  booster            = "gbtree",
  eta                = 0.07,
  max_depth          = 7,
  subsample          = 0.90,
  colsample_bytree   = 0.90,
  min_child_weight   = 3,
  objective          = "reg:squarederror",
  eval_metric        = "rmse"
)

# Entraînement du modèle XGBoost
model_xgb_tuned <- xgb.train(
  params  = params_extended,
  data    = dtrain,
  nrounds = 400,
  verbose = 1
)

# Prédictions sur le jeu de test
pred_xgb_tuned <- predict(model_xgb_tuned, dtest)

# Évaluation
rmse_xgb_tuned <- sqrt(mean((test_xgb$totalFare - pred_xgb_tuned)^2))
r2_xgb_tuned   <- cor(test_xgb$totalFare, pred_xgb_tuned)^2
mape_xgb       <- mape(test_xgb$totalFare, pred_xgb_tuned)

cat("=== XGBoost final (400 rounds) ===\n")
cat("RMSE :", round(rmse_xgb_tuned, 2), "\n")
cat("R²   :", round(r2_xgb_tuned, 4), "\n")
cat("MAPE :", round(mape_xgb, 2), "%\n")
```

```{r}
df_model_ss <- df_model %>% select(-coalesce_score)

train_ss <- df_model_ss[ idx_train, ]
test_ss  <- df_model_ss[-idx_train, ]

set.seed(42)
model_rf_ss <- ranger(
  totalFare ~ .,
  data          = train_ss,
  num.trees     = 100,
  mtry          = floor(sqrt(ncol(train_ss) - 1)),
  min.node.size = 5,
  importance    = "impurity",
  num.threads   = 4
)

pred_rf_ss <- predict(model_rf_ss, data = test_ss)$predictions
rmse_rf_ss <- sqrt(mean((test_ss$totalFare - pred_rf_ss)^2))
r2_rf_ss   <- cor(test_ss$totalFare, pred_rf_ss)^2
mape_rf_ss <- mape(test_ss$totalFare, pred_rf_ss)

comparaison_score <- tibble(
  Modèle = c("Random Forest avec score Reviews", "Random Forest sans score Reviews"),
  RMSE   = c(rmse_rf,    rmse_rf_ss),
  R2     = c(r2_rf,      r2_rf_ss),
  MAPE   = c(mape_rf,    mape_rf_ss)
)

print(comparaison_score)

ggplot(comparaison_score, aes(x = Modèle, y = RMSE, fill = Modèle)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(RMSE, 2)), vjust = -0.4, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4CAF50", "#F44336")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(title = "Impact du score Reviews sur la prédiction du prix",
       subtitle = "Valeur ajoutée de la fusion des deux datasets",
       x = NULL, y = "RMSE ($)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
# Aucune amélioration avec le score, logique car la satisfaction du client est une conséquence de la qualité du service et non un facteur.
